title: Have to reseal everything in 3 months or less
text:
Have to reseal everything in 3 months or less. Sometimes much less. As in 3 days ago. Right away I noticed some things were getting air in pretty quickly. Attributed to my aging Foodsaver 3240 or maybe sharp food. I thought some others were holding up OK over the last few months. Today I reorganized my freezer and what did I find? Almost everything packed even just in March has air. Actually, I think 100% has air. Many non-sharp foods such boneless chicken breast or burgers have lost the seal. In the last month I have been using some real Foodsaver precut bags I picked up on clearance. Not a one has lost air. Only a month but when you consider I have burgers I sealed last Friday in these that have already lost the seal. Have to say these are just no good for me. For short term storage maybe they would be ok value for some people.

I have used off-brand rolls before and I have a review here somewhere on those. They were not great but they did perform better than this. Really disappointed. I try to keep things for 6 months to a year in Zero degrees and I am very upset I have to reseal everything in a different brand of roll today. I should have checked my stuff sooner. It only suffers cosmetically and flavor-wise. But a lot of work to reseal probably fifty items.
